videos.script: Some answers are not in your data at all. Which region a state is in. Whether a date was a holiday. What a city's official code is. {{outside}} Enrichment is bringing that in from outside, and joining it on. {{join}} Done well, it does two jobs at once. The state column has thirteen spellings. Matched against the official list, it comes out as four clean codes, each with its region. {{clean}} The holiday calendar explains a gap in the shop sales that looked like missing data. The shops were closed. {{gap}} But every outside table brings questions with it. Who published it. When. Under what terms. And whether it will still say the same thing next year. {{provenance}} And one question that matters more than the rest. What did you send out to get it? A customer's postcode sent to somebody's web service is personal data leaving the company. {{privacy}} So this lesson enriches from files kept locally, with their source written down beside them. {{end}}
